messages.subject: Time recording — October narratives outstanding
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi both,

A few October time entries are missing narratives against matter WC-00145 and two other matters. Please complete them by Friday so we can finalise the monthly bills. The system will lock October at month-end.

Thanks,
Accounts
